source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Sort contaminated linen in the client room before bagging so heavily soiled pieces can be separated early.","B":"Handle contaminated linen with minimum agitation and contain it at the point of use, using leak-resistant containment when indicated.","C":"Shake contaminated linen before bagging to remove loose material and reduce the laundry load.","D":"Prerinse contaminated linen in the patient-care area before placing it in the transport container."}}
source_row.rationale: CDC recommends minimum agitation of contaminated textiles, containment at the point of use, no sorting or prerinsing in patient-care areas, and leak-resistant containment when textiles are contaminated with blood or body substances.
source_row.source_detail: Minimum agitation, point-of-use containment, and leak-resistant bags when indicated Source has no separate formal version identifier in the cited page metadata; live currentness and applicability rechecked 2026-08-15.
